title: Current-State Foundation Authority Index
purpose: Route future developer and AI-agent work to the current semantic corpus, decisions, validators, proofs, evidence, and dev handover while preserving historical lineage as audit evidence.
authorityBoundary: This index routes current work. It does not override the Charter, Authority Model, accepted ADRs, validators, proof evidence, or semantic instances.

optimisationActions.assuranceImpact: Future work has a current entry point that avoids treating historical migration artefacts as active authority.
Historical source-use, parity, closure, bootstrap, and generated outputs remain retained but are bounded.
Future developer and AI-agent workflow starts from current canonical authority and evidence.
No files are removed and no validators, planted defects, proofs, runtime code, provider code, or generated outputs are weakened.

futureWorkflowRules: Read current semantic contracts, ADRs, validators, proof evidence, and enterprise evidence before implementation.
Use superseded external-lineage, source-use, parity, closure, and bootstrap artefacts only as lineage or audit inputs when explicitly needed.
Do not infer readiness or source issue completion from wrapper, closure, or generated reports.
Update semantic contracts, proofs, validators, planted defects, enterprise evidence, and Linear acceptance mapping together when behaviour or assurance posture changes.
Preserve explicit non-claims unless a later issue separately proves and authorises a stronger claim.
When any semantic instance family changes, propagate staleness to mapped proof evidence, generated reports, and human review decisions until refreshed evidence proves the changed state.
Future AI-agent UI-definition work may consume the semantic corpus and authority index as input only; it must not infer product UI readiness or browser E2E readiness from foundation closure evidence.

stalenessPropagationPolicy.changedSemanticDefinitionAction: Mark dependent proof evidence, generated reports, external-review cockpit views, and prior human decisions superseded until validators and evidence are refreshed against the changed commit.
stalenessPropagationPolicy.changedProofOrEvidenceAction: Mark generated reports and human review decisions stale when their source SHA, evidence hash, or chain-of-custody anchor no longer matches the current evidence record.
stalenessPropagationPolicy.generatedReportAction: Generated reports must not upgrade stale, unknown, missing, or superseded raw evidence to pass or current state.
stalenessPropagationPolicy.humanDecisionAction: Human review decisions remain visible for audit history but are superseded when mapped evidence, semantic definitions, or source SHA changes.
stalenessPropagationPolicy.validatorFailureMode: Fail closed when new or changed semantic definitions lack proof, evidence, classification, authority-index coverage, or review posture.

aiUiCompositionBoundary.purpose: Define how future AI-agent UI-definition work may consume the current semantic corpus without converting foundation proof into product UI readiness.
allowedConsumers: AI agents reading semantic definitions and authority index entries
future UI-definition generators using semantic contracts as input
human reviewers inspecting evidence and current-state routing
aiUiCompositionBoundary.requiredBoundary: AI-generated or UI-generated definitions must remain proposals until semantic definitions, validators, proof evidence, enterprise evidence, and human review are updated and accepted.
